platform: Hand-off-only networks: Snapchat, WhatsApp (Status/Channels), Google Business Profile, Twitch, Signal Stories, Substack Notes, Instagram Stories

official_api.name: None usable by a personal account for any of the 7 targets. Business/approved APIs exist for: Google Business Profile (v4 localPosts, approval-gated), Instagram Stories (Instagram Platform API, professional account + app review), WhatsApp Business Platform (paid, business messaging only; cannot post Status or Channels), Twitch Helix (chat messages/announcements/clips only - no 'posts'), Snapchat Public Profile API (Marketing API partners, brands/creators). Signal Stories and Substack Notes have NO official API at all.
official_api.auth: GBP: Google OAuth2 (scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/business.manage, or legacy plus.business.manage), project quota is 0 QPM until Google approves the 'Application for Basic API Access' contact-form request (then 300 QPM). Instagram: Business Login for Instagram - GET https://www.instagram.com/oauth/authorize?client_id&redirect_uri&response_type=code&scope=instagram_business_basic,instagram_business_content_publish; code exchange POST https://api.instagram.com/oauth/access_token REQUIRES client_secret (no PKCE documented); long-lived via GET https://graph.instagram.com/access_token?grant_type=ig_exchange_token (60 days); refresh GET https://graph.instagram.com/refresh_access_token?grant_type=ig_refresh_token; redirect_uri must exactly match a registered base URI. Twitch: OAuth2 at https://id.twitch.tv/oauth2/authorize (implicit for client-side/mobile apps, auth-code needs secret) plus Device Code Grant Flow (POST https://id.twitch.tv/oauth2/device, then POST https://id.twitch.tv/oauth2/token with grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device_code) which 'does not need to maintain a client secret' and can refresh without one; PKCE not documented. WhatsApp Business Platform: Meta business portfolio + WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) + business phone number; system-user tokens; irrelevant for Status/Channels. Snapchat Public Profile API: part of Marketing API, partner/brand access.
oauth_scopes: user:write:chat / user:bot / channel:bot (Twitch Send Chat Message)

endpoints.purpose: GBP: create local post (business accounts only; requires API access approval)
endpoints.request_shape: JSON LocalPost: {languageCode:'en-US', summary:'...', topicType:'STANDARD'|'EVENT'|'OFFER'|'ALERT', callToAction:{actionType:'BOOK'|'ORDER'|'SHOP'|'LEARN_MORE'|'SIGN_UP'|'CALL', url}, media:[{mediaFormat:'PHOTO', sourceUrl:'https://...'}], event:{title, schedule:{startDate,startTime,endDate,endTime}} (required for EVENT/OFFER), offer:{couponCode, redeemOnlineUrl, termsConditions}, alertType (ALERT only)}
endpoints.response_shape: The created LocalPost resource (name: accounts/*/locations/*/localPosts/*, state, createTime, searchUrl)
endpoints.notes: v4 API; 'Product Posts cannot be created using the Google My Business API at this time.' media supports sourceUrl only (public URL, no upload). Posts older than 6 months are archived unless a date range is set.

endpoints.purpose: Instagram Stories: create story container (professional account only)
endpoints.request_shape: form/query params: media_type=STORIES, image_url=<public JPEG URL> OR video_url=<public MP4/MOV URL>; access_token. (Captions not documented for stories; user_tags supported since 2025-07-09.)
endpoints.notes: Then POST /{ig-user-id}/media_publish?creation_id=<id>. 100 API-published posts per 24h moving window (GET /{ig-user-id}/content_publishing_limit); 400 containers per rolling 24h. Image 8 MB max, 9:16 recommended; video MOV/MP4, 100 MB max, 60 s max. Host with Facebook Login uses graph.facebook.com instead.

endpoints.purpose: Twitch: Send Chat Message (closest thing to 'posting')
endpoints.request_shape: JSON {broadcaster_id, sender_id, message (max 500 chars), reply_parent_message_id?}; headers Authorization: Bearer <user token>, Client-Id
endpoints.notes: Scopes user:write:chat + user:bot (or channel:bot). Not a persistent post; only visible in live chat.
Scope moderator:manage:announcements. No Helix endpoint exists for channel feed/posts/panels.

endpoints.purpose: Twitch: Modify Channel Information (stream title etc.)

endpoints.notes: Scope clips:edit; only works while live.

official_api.free_tier: GBP API: free but 0 QPM until approved; 300 QPM after approval (verified 2026-10-07). Instagram API: free, 100 API-published posts/24h, professional account required (verified 2026-10-07). Twitch Helix: free. WhatsApp Business Platform: per-message billing since 2025-07-01 (marketing/utility/authentication templates charged; free-form 'service' messages inside an open 24h customer-service window are free) - none of which can post Status or Channels. Snapchat Public Profile API: partner/brand only.
official_api.paid_tiers: WhatsApp Business Platform per-message pricing by template category and recipient country (effective 2025-07-01). Others: no paid tiers that unlock personal posting.
official_api.rate_limits: GBP 300 QPM per project after approval. Instagram 100 posts/24h, 400 containers/24h. Twitch standard Helix bucket (not specified per endpoint on reference page); chat message 500 chars.
official_api.token_lifetime_and_refresh: Instagram: short-lived 1h -> long-lived 60 days, refreshable via graph.instagram.com/refresh_access_token. Twitch: user access tokens 4 hours; device-code refresh token expires after 30 days of inactivity; refresh without secret in device code flow. Google: standard OAuth2 refresh tokens.
official_api.app_review_required: GBP: yes - 'Application for Basic API Access' form; applicant must 'Manage a Google Business Profile that is verified and active for 60+ days', have a website for the business, and use an email listed as owner/manager. Instagram: app must pass App Review for instagram_business_content_publish before non-tester accounts can use it; in Development mode only app-role users (admins/developers/testers) work. Snapchat Snap Kit: 'All integrations are subject to our review and approval'. Twitch: no review for Helix. Snapchat Creative Kit Web: no registration needed (optional snapchat:app_id meta tag for metrics).
official_api.unreviewed_app_restrictions: GBP: 0 QPM (API unusable) until approved. Instagram: Development-mode app works only for accounts holding an app role; each tester still needs a professional (Business/Creator) account. Snapchat Creative Kit Lite (native): needs a Client ID from https://kit.snapchat.com; production use subject to Snap review. Twitch: none.
official_api.account_requirements: GBP: owner/manager of a verified GBP, 60+ days old. Instagram: professional account (Business or Creator); with Instagram Login no Facebook Page needed. WhatsApp Business Platform: business portfolio + WABA + business number. Snapchat Public Profile API: brand/creator public profile via Marketing API partner. Twitch: any account (chat only). Signal/Substack Notes: no API at all.
official_api.media_upload_flow: GBP: media via public sourceUrl only. Instagram: public image_url/video_url (or resumable upload for video). Twitch: n/a. Others: n/a.
official_api.server_side_scheduling: Instagram: none (publish immediately). GBP: event/offer posts carry date ranges but no scheduled publish. Others: none.

handoff.web_intent_url: WhatsApp: https://wa.me/?text=<urlencoded> (no recipient; opens chat picker) or https://api.whatsapp.com/send/?text=<urlencoded>; desktop resolves to https://web.whatsapp.com/send/?text=<text> (verified live 2026-10-07). Neither targets Status or Channels - user must pick/forward manually. Snapchat Web (Creative Kit Web): include <script src="https://sdk.snapkit.com/js/v1/create.js"> button with data-share-url=<attachment URL>; desktop opens a Snapcode window, mobile deep-links to the app; only an attachment URL (OG title/site_name read from the page) - no caption prefill. Substack Notes: https://substack.com/notes (composer, no documented prefill params). Google Business Profile: https://business.google.com/ (posts are created in Search/Maps 'Your business on Google' UI; no prefill params). Twitch: https://dashboard.twitch.tv/ (no public composer; chat at https://www.twitch.tv/popout/<channel>/chat). Instagram Stories: no web composer for stories. Signal: none (signal.me/#p/<number> opens a chat; stories cannot be prefilled from web).
handoff.web_intent_params: WhatsApp: text (URL-encoded; '+' accepted for spaces on web.whatsapp.com). Snapchat Web: data-share-url only (optional meta name="snapchat:app_id" for metrics, optional data-share-sticker etc.). Others: none.
handoff.android_share: WhatsApp: ACTION_SEND text/plain or image/*|video/* to package com.whatsapp (also com.whatsapp.w4b for WhatsApp Business); user then chooses a chat, 'My status' or a Channel in WhatsApp's own picker (Status/Channel targets appear in the WhatsApp share picker; cannot be preselected). Snapchat: package com.snapchat.android; Creative Kit Lite intent with extras CLIENT_ID (Snap Kit client id), captionText (<=250 chars), sticker (JSON), lensUUID, lensLaunchData; media via FileProvider content URI; plain ACTION_SEND image/*/video/* to com.snapchat.android also opens the Snapchat preview. Instagram Stories: Intent action com.instagram.share.ADD_TO_STORY, setDataAndType(contentUri, image/jpeg|image/png|video/mp4), extras source_application=<Facebook App ID, REQUIRED since Jan 2023>, interactive_asset_uri, top_background_color, bottom_background_color, content_url (link sticker, unverified); add FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION; resolve against package com.instagram.android. Plain ACTION_SEND image/* to com.instagram.android opens feed/story chooser without caption. Signal: package org.thoughtcrime.securesms; ShareActivity (.sharing.v2.ShareActivity) accepts ACTION_SEND / SEND_MULTIPLE for text/plain, image/*, video/*, audio/*, application/*, */* - Signal's picker lets the user choose 'My Story' or a story for a group. Substack: package com.substack.app (unverified, no story-like target; ACTION_SEND text/plain may open Notes composer - unverified). Twitch: package tv.twitch.android.app (unverified); no composer target. Google Business Profile: no app (GMB app discontinued 2022); posts via Google Maps app com.google.android.apps.maps 'Your business' - no share target.
handoff.ios_share: WhatsApp: URL scheme whatsapp://send?text=<urlencoded> (text only); for media use UIActivityViewController - WhatsApp's share extension lets user pick chat/Status (unverified exact key: 'whatsapp' in LSApplicationQueriesSchemes). Snapchat: Creative Kit Lite - write UIPasteboard items with keys com.snapchat.creativekit.clientID, com.snapchat.creativekit.backgroundImage, com.snapchat.creativekit.stickerImage, com.snapchat.creativekit.captionText, com.snapchat.creativekit.lensUUID then open snapchat://creativekit/camera (empty camera + overlay) or snapchat://creativekit/preview (prefilled photo/video); add 'snapchat' to LSApplicationQueriesSchemes. Instagram Stories: write UIPasteboard with com.instagram.sharedSticker.backgroundImage / .backgroundVideo / .stickerImage / .backgroundTopColor / .backgroundBottomColor (and .contentURL, unverified), then open instagram-stories://share?source_application=<Facebook App ID>; add 'instagram-stories' to LSApplicationQueriesSchemes. Signal: scheme sgnl:// (registered; only deep links like sgnl://signal.me, no compose scheme); share via UIActivityViewController to Signal's share extension (user picks story). Substack: share sheet to Substack app (unverified scheme substack://). Twitch: twitch:// (unverified); no compose target.
handoff.desktop: WhatsApp: open https://web.whatsapp.com/send/?text=<text> or the WhatsApp Desktop app via whatsapp://send?text= (protocol handler registered by the desktop app - unverified); Status and Channel posts must be created manually in WhatsApp Web/Desktop UI (Channels admin UI exists on web; Status composing on desktop is limited). Snapchat: https://web.snapchat.com (Snapchat for Web) - manual; Creative Kit Web shows a Snapcode to scan. GBP: https://business.google.com/ then 'Add update' - manual; or Google Search 'Your business on Google'. Twitch: https://dashboard.twitch.tv/ - set title/announcement manually; NEFORUM could use Helix for chat announcement/title. Signal: Signal Desktop can view and post stories (unverified) - open signal:// not available; copy text to clipboard. Substack Notes: open https://substack.com/notes with text copied to clipboard. Instagram Stories: no desktop story composer in web UI (web create = feed/reels only); copy text + reveal media file.
handoff.notes: Text prefill: WhatsApp (text via ?text= / whatsapp://send?text=; user picks target incl. Status or Channel), Snapchat Creative Kit (captionText <= 250 chars, native only), Signal (ACTION_SEND text/plain -> can become a text story). Media prefill: WhatsApp (share sheet), Snapchat (photo/video/sticker up to 300 MB, video <= 5 min split into 10 s snaps), Instagram Stories (background image >= 720x1280 JPG/PNG or H.264/H.265/WebM video <= 20 s, <= 50 MB recommended, up to 1080p; NO text/caption prefill), Signal (image/video via share sheet). No prefill at all: Google Business Profile, Twitch, Substack Notes (manual paste).

text_limits.counting_rule: Snapchat Creative Kit caption: 250 characters (counting rule not specified; assume UTF-16 code units). Twitch chat/announcement: 500 characters. Instagram Stories: no text field via share intent or API (text must be baked into the image). WhatsApp status text / Channels: entered in-app (Status text ~700 chars, unverified). Google Business Profile post summary: 1,500 characters (unverified, widely cited). Substack Notes: no hard documented limit (unverified). Signal text story: in-app only.
text_limits.notes: title_max 58 is the Google Business Profile event/offer title limit (unverified). hashtags_max 0 = no documented hashtag cap on any of these. WhatsApp wa.me text must be URL-encoded (percent-encoding; '+' is rendered as space on web.whatsapp.com).

media_limits.image_formats: Snapchat: PNG/JPEG up to 300 MB, 9:16 suggested, one sticker (<= 1 MB static PNG/JPEG; animated WebP/GIF iOS only). Instagram Stories share: JPG/PNG min 720x1280, 9:16 or 9:18; API: JPEG only, 8 MB max via public URL. Google Business Profile API: media sourceUrl (public URL) only, PHOTO; GBP UI photo minimum 400x300 / 10 KB to 5 MB (unverified). WhatsApp share sheet: whatever the app accepts (JPEG/PNG; Status compresses). Signal: image/* via share sheet.
media_limits.aspect_ratio: 9:16 vertical for Snapchat and Instagram Stories; GBP posts landscape 4:3 recommended (unverified)
media_limits.video: Snapchat: MP4/MOV, up to 5 min, 300 MB, auto-split into 10 s snaps. Instagram Stories share intent: H.264/H.265/WebM, up to 1080p, max 20 s, under 50 MB recommended; Instagram API stories video: MOV/MP4, 100 MB, 60 s max. WhatsApp Status video: 30 s per status (unverified). Signal stories: video via share sheet (Signal trims long stories, unverified). GBP: video via UI only (API media is PHOTO sourceUrl; video 30 s / 75 MB in UI, unverified).

gotchas: WhatsApp: wa.me / whatsapp://send?text= prefill a MESSAGE, not a Status or Channel post. The user must tap the 'My status' or Channel entry in WhatsApp's own target picker after share-sheet hand-off; there is no public API for Status or Channels, and the paid WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API) cannot post to either.
WhatsApp Business Platform billing is per message since 2025-07-01 and requires a Meta business portfolio + WABA + dedicated business phone number; it is irrelevant for a personal cross-poster.

Snapchat Creative Kit never posts directly: it opens Snapchat's camera/preview and the user still taps Send/Post (friends, My Story, Spotlight). It requires a Snap Kit Client ID from https://kit.snapchat.com even for 'Lite' (no-SDK) integration; the Web variant (sdk.snapkit.com create.js) needs no registration but only shares an attachment URL (no caption).

Snapchat Creative Kit Lite deep links: snapchat://creativekit/camera and snapchat://creativekit/preview with UIPasteboard keys com.snapchat.creativekit.* (iOS) and Intent extras CLIENT_ID/captionText/sticker/lensUUID to package com.snapchat.android (Android). Caption max 250 chars; only one sticker; animated stickers unsupported on Android.

Snapchat Public Profile API (Marketing API) lets 'partners post various content types on behalf of brands or creators' but is a business/partner integration tied to Public Profiles, not personal accounts; the old marketingapi.snapchat.com reference site is being deprecated in 2025 in favour of developers.snap.com/api.

Google Business Profile API project quota defaults to 0 QPM; you must submit the GBP API contact form ('Application for Basic API Access') and prove you manage a verified GBP active 60+ days with a website. A FOSS app cannot ship a shared approved project; each user would need their own approved Google Cloud project - realistically hand-off only.
GBP localPosts.create (v4) only accepts media by public sourceUrl, cannot create Product posts, and posts auto-archive after 6 months.

Twitch has no 'post' concept via API: Helix offers chat messages/announcements (500 chars), stream title/tags (PATCH /helix/channels), clips and markers. Twitch's own 'Channel feed' was removed years ago. Twitch OAuth: implicit grant for mobile/client-side, auth-code requires client secret, Device Code Grant needs no secret and can refresh without one; PKCE is not documented; user tokens live 4 h.

Instagram Stories via API: professional (Business/Creator) account only, media_type=STORIES, public image_url/video_url, 100 API-published posts per 24 h, no caption field, app must pass App Review for instagram_business_content_publish; the token exchange at api.instagram.com/oauth/access_token requires the client_secret (BYOK users must create their own Meta app and embed their own secret).

Instagram Stories share hand-off REQUIRES a Facebook App ID in source_application (Android extra / iOS query param) since January 2023 or Instagram shows 'The app you shared from doesn't currently support sharing to Stories'. No text/caption prefill - bake text into the image. Background >= 720x1280, video <= 20 s.

Signal: no API, no web composer. Share-sheet to org.thoughtcrime.securesms (Android ShareActivity accepts text/plain, image/*, video/*, */*) lets the user pick My Story / group story. iOS registers only the sgnl:// scheme (deep links, no compose). signal-cli (unofficial, links as a secondary device) has a sendStory command (attachment only, --group-id, --no-replies) - desktop-only, Java, ToS-grey.

Substack Notes: no official API; python-substack and NHagar/substack_api do not create Notes (drafts/read-only). Any Notes posting would hit undocumented endpoints (e.g. POST https://substack.com/api/v1/comment/feed - unverified) with the substack.sid cookie; hand-off is open https://substack.com/notes with text on clipboard.
Web search budget was exhausted mid-research; several hand-off identifiers (WhatsApp iOS scheme, Twitch/Substack package names, GBP text limits) are from recollection - see unverified_claims.
unverified_claims: wa.me canonical formats https://wa.me/<E.164 number>?text=<urlencoded> and https://wa.me/?text=<urlencoded> (FAQ page https://faq.whatsapp.com/5913398998672934 returned only a truncated header; the api.whatsapp.com/send/?text= landing page was verified live instead).
iOS WhatsApp scheme whatsapp://send?text=<urlencoded> and 'whatsapp' LSApplicationQueriesSchemes entry; WhatsApp Business Android package com.whatsapp.w4b.
WhatsApp Channels have no public API and Status text limit (~700 chars) / Status video limit (30 s).
Baileys (WhatsApp Web protocol library) can post to Status by sending to the 'status@broadcast' JID - README fetched did not confirm; community issues say it works but is a ban risk.
Instagram Android extra content_url and iOS pasteboard keys com.instagram.sharedSticker.contentURL / .backgroundVideo (not present in the fetched doc excerpt).
Instagram package name com.instagram.android (doc checks 'the Instagram package' but the fetched excerpt did not print the literal).

Substack Android package com.substack.app, iOS scheme substack://, and undocumented Notes endpoint POST https://substack.com/api/v1/comment/feed with body {bodyJson:{type:'doc',attrs:{schemaVersion:'v1'},content:[...]}, tabId:'for-you', replyMinimumRole:'everyone'} using the substack.sid cookie.

Twitch Android package tv.twitch.android.app and iOS scheme twitch://; Twitch OAuth redirect URLs accept http://localhost with a port for desktop apps (community practice, register-app page did not state rules).

Google Business Profile post text limit 1,500 characters, title 58 characters, photo min 400x300 px / 10 KB-5 MB, video <= 30 s / 75 MB; GBP mobile app discontinued in 2022 (posts now via Google Maps app / Search).
Signal Desktop can post stories; Signal share extension on iOS lets the user choose a story target.
Snapchat Snap Kit apps in development mode are limited to a small list of demo users until App Review; Creative Kit sharing to Spotlight is only offered for video.
Snapchat Creative Kit Web deep link format https://www.snapchat.com/scan?attachmentUrl=<url> (seen in community posts, not in fetched doc).

Open-source WebView/session automation projects for these targets: instagrapi (IG private API, stories supported - verified exists), Baileys / whatsapp-web.js (WhatsApp Web linked-device protocol - Baileys verified exists), signal-cli (verified, sendStory), dreammis/social-auto-upload (Playwright-based uploader, platforms unverified). No known FOSS library drives Substack Notes, Google Business Profile posts, Snapchat stories or Twitch via a logged-in web session.

web_session.how: Flutter embedded WebView (webview_flutter / flutter_inappwebview) with the user's own cookies: WhatsApp Web (web.whatsapp.com supports Channels admin posting and viewing Status; QR-link as a linked device), Snapchat for Web (web.snapchat.com - chats and stories are limited), Substack (substack.com/notes composer is plain React - inject text via JS and click Post, or call the undocumented /api/v1/comment/feed with the session cookie), Google Business Profile (business.google.com 'Add update' form - heavy anti-automation, Google login in WebView is often blocked as 'insecure browser'), Twitch (dashboard.twitch.tv, pointless because Helix covers chat/title), Instagram (web Create does not support Stories; instagrapi-style private-API emulation needed for stories). Signal has no web client at all (only signal-cli / linked-device protocol).
known_libraries: instagrapi (Python, private mobile API, photo_upload_to_story / video_upload_to_story; 'best suited for testing, research, and controlled internal automation')
Baileys (TypeScript WhatsApp Web socket API, QR/pairing-code linked device; maintainers 'do not condone... automated messaging usage')
whatsapp-web.js (Puppeteer-driven WhatsApp Web; unverified status support)
python-substack (undocumented Substack interfaces; drafts only, no Notes)
web_session.risk: High for Instagram (Meta aggressively challenges/locks accounts using private-API emulation; instagrapi itself warns automation is 'fragile in production' due to 'account trust, proxies, device state, challenges, and rate limits') and WhatsApp (ToS forbids automation; Baileys explicitly disclaims liability; number bans are common for bulk/automated use). Medium for Substack (undocumented API, no public ban reports, but interfaces 'may change without notice'). Medium-high for Google (login in embedded WebView frequently rejected; automation of business.google.com violates Google ToS). Low for Twitch (official Helix covers the useful actions). Signal: linked-device protocol via signal-cli is tolerated by Signal but Stories are attachment-only there; no web UI to drive. Snapchat web: low utility, automation flagged by Snap's anti-bot measures.
